selection: First result of every existing query/language/method row; no favorable case selection. Preserve empty results.
deduplication: Identical query, language and name share a name-only judgment; all original product IDs are retained.
admission: Frozen name-and-constraint guarded bounded judge must first pass all 32 v5 control judgments.
metrics: Full name match rate at 1, partial match count, unrelated count, abstentions and empty results. Abstentions are excluded from match-rate denominator and reported separately.
limitations: Top-1 development pilot, not full top-10 grading, recall, human preference, held-out generalization or grounds to promote semantic retrieval. PT/EN query pairs are correlated.
